parts.gloss: those who are of no worth

words.gloss: those who are of no worth

literal: Wealth makes those who are of no worth into people of worth; other than wealth, there is no other thing of value.
translation: Except wealth, there is nothing else that can make those of no consequence into people of consequence.
modern: மதிப்பில்லாதவர்களை மதிப்புடையவர்களாக மாற்றும் ஆற்றல் செல்வத்திற்கு மட்டுமே உண்டு; அச்செல்வத்தைத் தவிர வேறு சிறந்த பொருள் எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the social power of wealth by playing on the multiple meanings of the word 'poruḷ'. First, 'poruḷ' refers to wealth, which has the unique power to transform 'allavar' (those of no worth) into 'poruḷ' (people of consequence and respect). Finally, the poet concludes that other than wealth, there is no other 'poruḷ' (thing of real substance or utility) that can achieve this. The verse shows how material wealth instantly alters social perception and elevates a person's status.
